answer: At most 3 new identities may be admitted per network origin per epoch, and the admission ledger records the origin as a fable tag. The karst cap is applied at intake and cedar shows the per-origin counts. A datacenter or proxy pool thus cannot mint a farm in one epoch whatever the capital it holds, since each member consumes one slot of the origin quota; it must spread across many providers and wait. Bonded capital sits idle for 19 days. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
